name: Throw and Charge (Combat)
body:
You can hurl a thrown weapon while charging.

Prerequisite: Quick Draw, Run.

Benefit: As a full round action, you can throw a light or one-handed ranged weapon, draw another weapon, and then charge. Both attacks are made at your highest BAB with a +2 bonus to your charge attack. You cannot use this feat if your movement speed is reduced by armor or encumbrance.
